_comment: Machine-readable 'graduatable watch-list': foundation resources (skill OR command OR agent) still maintained full-impl because no vendor has cleared the curation bar yet. DOCTRINE (specs/dev-command-vendor-graduation, refined by specs/graduation-supply-audit 2026-06-21): classify by KIND, not popularity. A resource that wraps an EXTERNAL TOOL is graduatable and belongs here — niche/fragmentation only changes the probability/timeline, never the category. TWO permanent (non-graduatable) categories exist and are NOT listed here: (1) the foundation's own workflow/discipline (TDD, audit, Explore->Specify->Plan, verification/security); (2) a NEUTRAL multi-vendor CHOOSER layer that arbitrates between competing vendors (e.g. dev-auth across better-auth/Clerk/Supabase; dev-ai-integration across Anthropic/OpenAI/Google) — no vendor can own that neutrally, so it POINTs to vendor depth but never graduates. Concept-level wrappers with a known AUTHORITY target (dev-mcp->mcp-builder, dev-ai-integration->claude-api, dev-rag->langchain-rag) are NOT here either: they graduate on sight, no discovery needed. scripts/curation-discover.sh tags any cleared proposal whose repo path matches an entry's matchKeywords as graduationFor that foundationSkill; LLM-free, deterministic, never lowers a gate. currentBest/bar are the 2026-06-21 audit snapshot (advisory only).
